cohort: The study participants were 223 newborns admitted to the nursery with Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia (NH) at Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital.
finding: Older age at admission, gestational age between 35 and 37 weeks, and the presence of abnormal posture at admission were identified as independent predictors of increased mortality among neonates with unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia.
